entry.title: Optimal Execution via RL - International Fintech Conference 2025

link.title: Optimal Execution via RL - International Fintech Conference 2025

entry.content:
I presented at the International Fintech Research Conference on January 31, 2025, discussing Optimal Execution via Reinforcement Learning in Agent-Based Simulations.

My presentation focused on optimal execution strategies using reinforcement learning. I introduced the problem definition and its formulation as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), highlighting key aspects such as execution trajectories, market impact, and transaction cost minimization. I then delved into reinforcement learning algorithms, discussing Q-learning and Deep Q-Networks (DQN). Additionally, I explored the role of limit order book (LOB) simulations, comparing various execution policies against traditional approaches like TWAP and passive algorithms. Finally, I presented experimental results showcasing how reinforcement learning can minimize market impact while optimizing execution efficiency.

Download the slides [PDF].

Here you can find the arxiv paper: Optimal Execution via Reinforcement Learning in Agent Based Simulations.

entry.title: Quantitative Trading with Machine Learning - ECAI 2024

link.title: Quantitative Trading with Machine Learning - ECAI 2024

entry.content:
I presented at the Workshop on AI in Finance at ECAI 2024 in Santiago de Compostela, Spain on October 19, 2024. This workshop brought together researchers and practitioners from both industry and academia to discuss recent advancements in AI applications for financial services.

My presentation focused on quantitative trading with machine learning. I covered a range of topics, starting with classical strategies such as momentum, mean reversion, and seasonality. Then, I delved into more advanced techniques, exploring the application of reinforcement learning in trading. Finally, I discussed higher frequency trading strategies and their implementation with futures contracts.

You can find more details about the workshop and its program on the official website.

entry.title: Article: I vantaggi di fare rifornimento sulla luna

link.title: Article: I vantaggi di fare rifornimento sulla luna

entry.content:
I recently published an article on Space Economy on the italian news outlet Airpress. In the article I explore the concept of moon mining for in-orbit refueling. The article delves into the potential advantages of extracting resources from the moon to support space missions, reduce costs, and enhance the sustainability of space exploration. I examine the technological, economic, and environmental aspects of lunar resource utilization and its implications for the future of space travel.

Download the article [PDF]

entry.title: AAAI 2024 conference Bridge
entry.content:
I was invited to hold a seminar at the AAAI 2024 conference Bridge - AI for Financial Services, on the topic of Machine Learning in Financial Markets. This seminar was held together with Matteo Rampazzo, a colleague from Epsilon SGR. We started with a brief introduction on the uses of algorithms in the financial markets followed by an overview of the tecnical machine learning tools. We then had three main sections, the first on quantitative trading, then quantitative investing and finally on optimal execution.

entry.title: ICAIF 2023 conference - New York
entry.content:
This year, with colleagues from Intesa Sanpaolo, we submitted a paper which was accepted to the fourth edition of the International Conference on AI in Finance, 27 November - 29 December 2023 (website). The paper is: CVA Hedging with Reinforcement Learning. It was awarded the Runner-up Best Industrial Paper Award!

entry.title: RL for Algorithmic Trading - King’s College

link.title: RL for Algorithmic Trading - King’s College

entry.content:
I gave my first 2 hour lecture to the students of the MSc in Computational Finance at King’s College London. The topic was Reinforcement Learning in the Capital Markets. I had the chance to present most of my research, explaining how RL can be used to solve problems in the trading and hedging space.

Download the full slides [PDF].

entry.title: EMFCampus 2022 seminar - SDA Bocconi
entry.content:
On November 11 2022, together with the Cristian Giacomini, the CEO of Modefinance International and Emilio Colombo from Cerved, I held a seminar on Machine Learning Applications in Finance: Credit Scoring, Real Estate and Algorithmic Trading. I started with an introduction to machine learning and then explained two use cases of Algo Trading with RL.
